base_ranker: pse_candidate_v2_rank (source/config already frozen before its own withheld evaluation)
selection_constraint: development answerable recall >= 0.90, then maximize no-evidence abstention accuracy, then prefer simpler gate
selected_system: lexical similarity threshold plus question-echo veto
similarity: max(word cosine overlap, CJK character-bigram Jaccard)
margin_gate_incremental_value: none observed under the same >=0.90 answerable-recall constraint
chronology_note: The originally frozen validation split was inspected once after development selection but before this durable config commit; it is therefore descriptive only. A new post-freeze withheld set is required for clean generalization evidence.
claim_boundary: Auxiliary abstention research only; not Gate E completion or parity evidence.
